teachers_time_format.name: teachers_time_format
teachers_time_format.value: ("teachers"."start_time" is null or "teachers"."start_time" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$') and ("teachers"."end_time" is null or "teachers"."end_time" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$')

group_memberships_leave_pending.name: group_memberships_leave_pending
group_memberships_leave_pending.value: "group_memberships"."leave_pending_at" is null or ("group_memberships"."status" = 'paused' and "group_memberships"."left_at" is null)

groups_salary_override.name: groups_salary_override
groups_salary_override.value: ("groups"."teacher_salary_percent" is null or "groups"."teacher_salary_percent" between 0 and 100) and ("groups"."teacher_salary_amount" is null or "groups"."teacher_salary_amount" >= 0)

approval_requests_decided.name: approval_requests_decided
approval_requests_decided.value: ("approval_requests"."status" in ('pending', 'cancelled')) or ("approval_requests"."decided_by" is not null and "approval_requests"."decided_at" is not null)

lead_waitlists_closed.name: lead_waitlists_closed
lead_waitlists_closed.value: "lead_waitlists"."group_id" is null or "lead_waitlists"."closed_at" is not null

sms_provider_email_len.name: sms_provider_email_len
sms_provider_email_len.value: "sms_provider"."email" is null or length("sms_provider"."email") between 3 and 200

sms_provider_sender_len.name: sms_provider_sender_len
sms_provider_sender_len.value: "sms_provider"."sender" is null or length("sms_provider"."sender") between 1 and 20

coin_entries_manual.name: coin_entries_manual
coin_entries_manual.value: "coin_entries"."rule" <> 'manual' or ("coin_entries"."note" is not null and length("coin_entries"."note") between 1 and 300 and "coin_entries"."created_by" is not null)

lesson_grades_not_empty.name: lesson_grades_not_empty
lesson_grades_not_empty.value: "lesson_grades"."score" is not null or "lesson_grades"."homework" is not null
